author: dev_revs
body:
andddd... that's a wrap! Thank you to all teams and players who participated. I hope you enjoyed this wacky tournament and decide to come play for the next one. 

Here are the final results!
http://avicus.challonge.com/battleofeternityII

50 Shades of ALM- 1st PLACE

Praetorians- 2nd PLACE

Team Rocket- 3rd PLACE

Also, whoever was the owner of this bracket, was one point off of a 100% accurate bracket! Congrats! http://avicus.challonge.com/tournaments/4008821/predictions/170393

{tag=6a81760ce56942099de44e6f636ab030} decided to retire after this tournament, he will be dearly missed with the official team, please thank him.

You will see some changes about the event staff team within this week, some public, some not. Stay Tuned! 

FEEDBACK SURVEY!! https://goo.gl/forms/AJd4mG0n86it45VX2

Thank you guys for your commitment and patience,

Best Regards, The Avicus Official Team.
